phases.objective: Replace manual reconstruction of Frontend surface dispatch failures with one exact-candidate structured report, keep pull-request validation read-only, and isolate generated-evidence mutation behind an explicitly dispatched exact-head workflow.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Read-only Frontend surface dispatch on a pull request, with a separately dispatched governed refresh when generated evidence must change
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The pull-request workflow publishes bounded JSON and Markdown identifying the first failed verification stage or proving all checks, while any generated-evidence mutation rejects protected branches and stale expected-head SHAs.
steps: Checkout the exact pull-request candidate without persisted credentials for validation.
Fetch the canonical default branch and force the local canonical ref to the fetched origin ref.
Generate frontend dispatch, operation-governance, and runtime OpenAPI evidence against that exact canonical ref.
Run each frontend verification command as a named ordered evidence stage.
Check committed generated-output parity as a named evidence stage.
Stop at the first failure and retain bounded redacted diagnostics.
Upload the structured report before enforcing its decision.
Keep the pull-request workflow read-only with no repository push capability.
Require explicit target_branch and expected_head_sha inputs for refresh.
Reject main, Production, stale local heads, and stale remote heads before a bounded non-force push.
assertions: Pull-request evidence records merge-candidate SHA separately from source-head SHA.
Validation and refresh both move local main to origin/main after fetching.
The report names the first failed verification stage and exit code.
Diagnostics are bounded and redact authorization values, OAuth tokens, secrets, API keys, passwords, cookies, GitHub tokens, and JWT-shaped values.
Job logs are diagnostic-only and are consulted only when bounded structured diagnostics are absent.
The pull-request workflow has contents read permission only and contains no git push.
The mutating refresh workflow is workflow_dispatch-only and requires an exact expected head SHA.
The refresh workflow refuses main and Production and re-checks the remote branch head immediately before push.
Generated artifacts remain restricted to the three governed frontend evidence files.

phases.objective: Route the report and governed refresh result through the trusted canonical PR evidence publisher after both workflow definitions are present on the default branch.
Exercise process spawn faults, missing reports, oversized diagnostics, stale candidates, concurrent refresh pushes, and artifact upload failures.
Observe the first non-production exact-candidate report and verify reviewers no longer require manual Job-log reading.
Require canonical structured frontend verification evidence for protected release promotion while keeping protected branches outside refresh mutation scope.
